subject: Finalizing invoice ladder for Opentide booking milestones
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Michael O'Rourke <michael@opentide.com>, procurement@opentide.com
Date: 2028-12-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Finalizing invoice ladder for Opentide booking milestones

Team —

We need to lock the invoicing schedule for the Opentide contract to ensure Q4 bookings recognition. Summary below (also attached: Opentide_PO_Summary.xlsx):

- Total contract: $1,220,000 (SOW with 3 milestone invoices)
- Milestone A: 30% on contract execution (expected PO)
- Milestone B: 40% on platform delivery acceptance
- Milestone C: 30% on go-live

Key ask: can Finance accept invoices that arrive by 23:59 UTC on 2028-12-05 for inclusion in December bookings, assuming we receive a valid PO number before that cutoff? If the PO and invoice don’t arrive by the cutoff we will need to defer recognition to Jan and it will materially impact the month-end forecast.

Ben — please confirm where Opentide is on the PO cadence and whether procurement needs any follow-ups this week.
Priyom — can you validate that HubSpot milestone mapping is set so that when the PO lands we trigger the recognition workflow?
Laura/Vanessa — confirm required invoice fields (PO #, billing contact, milestone acceptance doc) so we don’t lose time on rework.

Cc'ing Michael and procurement at Opentide so they see the timing constraints. Appreciate quick confirmations.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0148


From: Michael O'Rourke <michael@opentide.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@opentide.com
Date: 2028-12-03T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Finalizing invoice ladder for Opentide booking milestones

Soojin —

Thanks for the heads-up. Procurement confirms they will issue a PO this week; I expect the PO PDF to be sent on 2028-12-04. A couple of clarifications:

- Opentide process: we send a single PO referencing the SOW and then will accept up to three invoices against that PO.
- For Milestone A we can issue an invoice as soon as the PO is available.
- We will need Redwood to confirm the billing contact and the exact invoice remit address to ensure quick processing.

If you can confirm that receiving the PO on 2028-12-04 and an invoice for Milestone A on 2028-12-05 will be sufficient for December recognition, we’ll prioritize it.

Michael
Head of Procurement
Opentide Systems
michael@opentide.com

Date: 2028-12-04T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Finalizing invoice ladder for Opentide booking milestones

Quick update — Opentide internal approvals complete. I spoke to Michael this morning: procurement will email the PO PDF tomorrow (12/04). Opentide is prioritizing Milestone A invoice so we should be able to get the invoice on 12/05.

I'll nudge procurement directly if we don't see the PO by midday PT on 12/04.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference


From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Michael O'Rourke <michael@opentide.com>, procurement@opentide.com
Date: 2028-12-06T17:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Finalizing invoice ladder for Opentide booking milestones

Thanks all — good cadence. Confirming Finance rules for recognition and what we need to hit the Dec window: 

1) PO number must be received and logged in NetSuite by 2028-12-05 23:59 UTC.
2) Invoice must be dated <= 2028-12-05 and include the PO number, billing contact, tax/VAT fields as applicable, and reference to the milestone acceptance document.
3) Milestone acceptance: a signed acceptance email or a signed delivery note (PDF) uploaded to the deal record is requires for Milestone B/C; for Milestone A the PO + invoice is sufficient.

If the PO lands on 2028-12-04 (as Michael indicated) and Opentide sends Milestone A invoice on 2028-12-05, we will treat the value as December bookings for forecasting and recognition. If any of the fields are missing we will need to hold recognition until corrected.

Action items:
- Michael/procurement@opentide.com: send PO PDF to billing@redwood.inference and cc laura_bennett@redwood.inference.
- Ben: confirm when you nudge procurement midday PT on 12/04 if PO still outstanding.
- Priyom: flag the HubSpot deal for immediate mapping when PO is uploaded (HubSpot deal ID in related links).
- Vanessa: be ready to create the invoice in NetSuite when the PO is confirmed; uses invoice-template.pdf (attached).

I'll hold a short (15m) call tomorrow if we need to triage — otherwise let's treat this as green.

Regards,

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference
